theorem Ring.additiveCommutators_le_comap {R : Type*} {S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S] (f : R →+* S) : Ring.additiveCommutators R ≤ (Ring.additiveCommutators S).comap f.toAddMonoidHom := by
  change AddSubgroup.closure {x : R | ∃ a b : R, x = a * b - b * a} ≤ _
  apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2
  rintro x ⟨a, b, rfl⟩
  change f (a * b - b * a) ∈ Ring.additiveCommutators S
  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul] using Ring.commutator_mem_additiveCommutators (f a) (f b)
